text:
maria: Heads-up — sprint-night meetup this Thurs at The Loft. Quick thread to lock booth staffing, speaker slots, and final swag counts. Need volunteers for 6:30–9:30pm shift and someone to own lead routing.
jenn: I can do 6:30–8pm. I'll take speaker mic handoff and run the mini-talk intro. :thumbsup:
ashok: i'll do 8–9:30pm. Can field product questions and handle demo signups.
maria: perfect. @jenn pls prep a 3-min script for intros. @ashok grab the demo laptop + HDMI adapter from ops closet.
leo: re: swag — current order status:
```
stickers: 300
tees: 120 (mixed S-XL)
pins: 200
stickers-sticker-zebra: 50 (special edition)
```
leo: shipping ETA Wed 3pm. If we need more tees we can rush 30 extras but cost +$120.
samir: how many leads do we expect? helps decide slab of paper forms vs QR flow.
maria: aim for 80 warm leads. Use QR form as primary, paper as fallback. We need lead routing to SDRs in real-time — can we get live Slack pings?
ashok: yes — we'll use the inbound webhook -> #sales-inbound. I'll configure filters: tag by region & interest.
jenn: also want a bench of 3x 1-min demos for the stage. @maria can you finalize which features? I'd keep it: 1) sub-100ms demo (latency), 2) cost-compare snippet, 3) offline private deploy pitch.
maria: agreed. I'll draft scripts tonight and share in docs.
leo: swag question — do we want to hand out the special edition zebra stickers only after demo sign-up or freely?
samir: reserve zebra for signups (makes it a conversion incentive). free stickers + pins otherwise.
maria: zebra for conversions. Also plan a small raffle: 1x $100 gift card for attendees who complete post-demo survey. Helps capture email.
jenn: logistics checklist for Thurs:
- booth table + 2 chairs (ops)
- power strip + backup battery (ops)
- laptop + HDMI (ashok)
- 2x iPad for QR check-in (maria)
- printed name badges + sharpies (leo)
- swag table signage + price list (samir)

leo: ops confirmed table & power. I'll swing by ops at 5pm to pick up printed badges.
samir: can someone create a 1-slide one-pager for the raffle and demo timings? i'll print 20 copies.
maria: i'll drop a draft in this thread in 30m.
swag-bot: Order update: tees 120 (in transit), stickers 300 (arrived warehouse), pins 200 (arrived). Tracking: https://logistics.example/track/ORD-6789
jenn: cool. one more ask — can design make a small booth backdrop with our 3 value props? need by Wed noon.
maria: pinging @design. (I'll @ them in the design channel too.)
ashok: inbound routing config (working notes):
```
webhook -> #sales-inbound
payload includes: name, email, company, region, demo_interest
rules:
  - if demo_interest == true -> tag: demo
  - if region in [NA, EU] -> assign SDR by region
```
ashok: will test webhook on Wed 10am. @leo pls give me test phone number for QR form.
leo: sending via DM.
maria: final ask — volunteers wearing tees? we should size-check. @jenn @ashok @leo pls confirm sizes by EOD.
jenn: M
ashok: L
leo: L
samir: M
maria: S for me. Thanks team — will post final run-of-show tomorrow morning. :rocket:
